faq.title: Frequently
faq.lead: Find answers to the most common queries about our visa and immigration services.

items.question: How do I change my visa appointment?
items.answer: Share your current date and we will request the next open slot with the centre and update you the same day.

items.question: How long does a student visa take?
items.answer: Most study files are ready in one to two weeks. Embassy time after submission depends on the country.

items.question: Can you help if I was refused before?
items.answer: Yes. We review the refusal letter, fix the weak points, and prepare a fresh file before you apply again.

items.question: Do you support family applications?
items.answer: We prepare spouse, child and parent files together so the documents stay consistent.

items.question: Which documents do I need to start?
items.answer: A passport scan, photo, and the purpose of travel are enough to begin. We send the full checklist after the first call.

items.question: How do I track my application?
items.answer: You get updates at each stage, from document check to the embassy decision, on email and phone.
